pages.text: A focus brimming with spatial energy, capable of teleporting the caster to a designated location.$(br)When casting with a Structure Eye or a map containing coordinates (such as a treasure map, woodland mansion map, etc.) in the off-hand, the caster will be teleported to the vicinity of the corresponding structure.$(br)Note: the Gateway Focus can only search for structures within the same dimension.$(br)$(4)"Tired of wasting precious time traveling on every expedition? Give this a try."$()
